voice.personality: A fennec fox, the desert's tinkerer: earnest, loves a plan and follows one to the letter, ears first. A little proud of his enormous ears, fond of digging.
voice.encourages: By praising the plan and the order of the steps: reading the grid first, following every block through, trying it and seeing.
voice.dares: A tinkerer's bet: plan a route before he digs a hole, read a whole program before running it, find the bug before his ears twitch.

lines: Ears up. Shall we build a plan?
The blocks are lined up. I lined them up twice.
One step, then the next. That's all a program is.
Fancy some coding? I've cleared the sand off the grid.
Hi, I'm Fennel. I follow plans to the letter. Want to write me one?
New to coding? Lovely. We start with one block and see what it does.
Hello. First lesson. You write the steps, I walk them.
Oh, hello. The grid is just as you left it.
There you are. My ears went straight up.
Welcome. We'll start with a plan you know.
Coding done today. Every step in order.
That's today's plan, run and done. I'm off to dig.
Done. My ears are doing a little victory twitch.
Done, and it's late. Desert foxes love the night. You go to bed.
Another day of plans. The grid knows your footsteps.
Done again. A month of this. I'm proud right to the tips of my ears.
{days} days of coding so far. That's a lot of tidy steps.
A rest day. Foxes nap in the shade at midday. Very sensible.
The grid can wait a day. I'll dig a little hole.
A lesson is here when you want it. Plan first, then go.
Fancy a puzzle? I've got one with a nice twist.
Your usual {usualHour} coding? I've stretched my ears.
Morning. The sand's cool. Good time for a plan.
Good morning. Shall we write the first step of the day?
Afternoon. It's hot out. Let's code in the shade.
A mid-afternoon puzzle? I've dug us a cool spot.
Evening. The desert's turning pink. Plan time.
An evening lesson. My ears hear the bugs better at this hour.
Night is fox time. One small puzzle, then bed for you.
Late-night coding. Very fennec of you.
{count} days of coding in a row. My ears are proud.
A week of plans. You and the grid get on well.
A month of coding. I've dug you a trophy. It's a hole.
{count} days in a row. That's a long, tidy program.
I bet you can't plan the whole route before I finish digging.
Dare you to read the whole program before you run it. Every block.
Bet you can't find the bug before my ears twitch.
Bet you can't solve one puzzle before the sand warms up.
I dare you to plan tomorrow's breakfast as a program. Step one: toast.
